question: Which of the following states renamed the dragon fruit as ‘Kamalam’ in January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__.

__
 
• **Gujarat states renamed the dragon fruit as ‘Kamalam’ in January 2021**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dragon fruit** is the fruit of a species of wild cactus indigenous to **South **and **Central America**, where it is called **pitaya** or **pitahaya.**

 
 
• **Vietnam** is the **world’s largest producer** and **exporter** of **dragon fruit.**
 
• **The word Kamalam** is **Sanskrit** for the** Lotus**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gujarat:**

 
 
• Animal - Asiatic Lion
 
• Bird - Greater Flamingo
 
• Flower - Marigold
 
• Tree - Banyan
